source_limits: Existing W01 body envelope, axle stations and wheel radii are reconstruction targets; the licensed source's eight-spoke wheels replace the old twelve-spoke construction in this separate master only.
Old Cart by Lyskilde/longtail is a cleared modern construction/optical comparison only, not an 1835 Chicago specimen or identified maker.
The 1893 Studebaker Farm Wagon No4 plate is a later period analogy only, not evidence of an 1835 Studebaker wagon.
Colours, species, wear, concealed joints and small hardware are bounded reconstruction.
No historical owner, load, working hitch, driver, suspension, brakes, traffic or boarding is asserted.

The central90x55mmreach and its front/rear fit are explicit new engineering reconstruction from the licensed shaft surface; originalbodyrails are not mislabeledasreach. The retainedkingbolt is separatelyowned withmeasured4.994mmeccentricity, notperfectcoaxial/loadcertification.
